lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Trump breaks silence on nationwide ground stop and demand more money from Congress, The Associated Press reports.
Megaspeed, which is under scrutiny over alleged transfers of advanced Nvidia chips to Chinese companies, also announced an internal investigation led by outside lawyers, The Associated Press reports.

Two planes collided Saturday night on the tarmac at Miami International Airport, just a day after a nationwide flight grounding caused widespread cancellations and travel chaos, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
